tasks.title: Define additive AI summary contracts
tasks.description: G-4, G-5, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-027, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-034, REQ-035, REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, FR-3, FR-5, FR-10, REQ-049, REQ-050, REQ-056, DR-2, DR-3, DR-4, and AC-11 / Component: Public contracts and task API - extend AIAssistantEventName, CC_AI_SUMMARY_EVENTS, CC_EVENTS, AGENT_EVENTS.FEATURE_ENABLEMENT, TASK_EVENTS.TASK_MID_CALL_SUMMARY_FOR_RECEIVING_AGENT, the SDK-produced output-only ITask interface, and payload/response types with the exact optional FeatureEnablementEventPayload.postCallEnabled and midCallEnabled boolean fields plus exact actionTimeStamp casing, explicit summaryReceived: true | false mid-call branches, and optional finite non-negative numeric actionTimeStamp/publishTimestamp fields on every response branch. Each feature flag remains independently optional in the type and has raw true | false | undefined semantics; no declaration normalizes absence. Declare package-internal SummaryResponseTimestamps, AISummaryResponseTransportPayload, AISummaryInboundType, AISummaryPayloadByInboundType, AISummaryTimeoutCodeByInboundType, AISummaryPendingRegistration, AISummaryRequestCoordinator, and GeneratedSummaryFlagsAccessor types, making each literal inbound type select its exact resolver payload and timeout code, requiring async atomic pending registration to return a handle whose fresh opaque requestToken identifies the accepted registration and whose result Promise has that selected payload, and including the task-owner argument on registration plus task owner and requestToken on cancellation, plus task/API method and timeout constants, the package-internal lifecycle-only AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED coordinator code, and metric names including AI_SUMMARY_INBOUND_EVENT_DROPPED. Make AIAssistantEventName the single source of all six exact outbound summary strings, and require adapter aliases and transport discriminants to derive only from those member value types. Retain GET_MID_CALL_SUMMARY with exact JSDoc `@deprecated Use GET_MID_CALL_CONSULT_SUMMARY for CONSULT or GET_MID_CALL_TRANSFER_SUMMARY for TRANSFER.` and retain MID_CALL_SUMMARY_RESPONSE with exact JSDoc `@deprecated Use MID_CALL_CONSULT_SUMMARY_RESPONSE for CONSULT or MID_CALL_TRANSFER_SUMMARY_RESPONSE for TRANSFER.`; no production SDK path may reference either compatibility-only member. Keep the existing CC_TASK_EVENTS.POST_CALL_SUMMARY and MID_CALL_SUMMARY literals as the single value sources for those shared wire names; define the corresponding CC_AI_SUMMARY_EVENTS members from the CC_TASK_EVENTS properties rather than duplicate literals, add literals only for FEATURE_ENABLEMENT and MID_CALL_SUMMARY_RESPONSE_SUBSEQUENT_AGENT, and spread CC_EVENTS in the exact order CC_AGENT_EVENTS, CC_TASK_EVENTS, then CC_AI_SUMMARY_EVENTS. The two CC_TASK_EVENTS members remain deprecated only as emitted-event names and are proven never emitted. Declare the six-value AI_SUMMARY_ERROR_CODES object in src/constants.ts and re-export it from src/index.ts for stable Error.message/data.errorCode matching; also declare package-internal AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE = 'WxCC' as const. Explicitly export the public payloads/constants from src/index.ts while omitting AISummaryInboundType, AISummaryPayloadByInboundType, AISummaryTimeoutCodeByInboundType, AISummaryPendingRegistration, AISummaryRequestCoordinator, GeneratedSummaryFlagsAccessor, AISummaryResponseTransportPayload, SummaryResponseTimestamps, AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED, and AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE from that barrel. In src/services/task/constants.ts, export package-internal AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS = 30_000 once and export AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS; also export package-internal AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED = 'AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED' as const; production and fake-timer test call sites import the applicable semantic alias and never inline the duration. Declare the exact MID_CALL_SUMMARY_RESPONSE_SUBSEQUENT_AGENT receiver event and add every approved public type, constant, event, metric, method signature, and barrel export without removing or renaming an existing symbol. Add test/unit/spec/index.ts as the additive root-barrel contract: use the existing TypeScript compiler API to preserve a literal frozen list of every pre-feature export plus each approved addition and to keep named internals absent. Inspect the two retained outbound legacy property declarations for the exact @deprecated text, resolve their symbols, and fail any production src/**/*.ts reference outside those declaration nodes, including alias/property/element/destructuring forms. The baseline and prohibition lists must be literal fixtures rather than generated snapshots. Extend services/config/index.ts tests to assert both shared-member identities, the two new raw discriminator literals, and CC_EVENTS membership under the normative spread order. Emit the four required ITask members and public response timestamp fields through the existing dist/types/index.d.ts path; use Pick/Partial for behavior-focused test doubles rather than complete structural implementations. Preserve the two generic outbound AI constants only as the deprecated compatibility declarations above, forbid new SDK references, and preserve all existing events. This is the contract root, so it has no prerequisite; generated declarations change, but package manifest, build configuration, export map, dependencies, and lockfile do not.

tasks.title: Add exact AI Assistant summary transport
tasks.description: REQ-010, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-034, REQ-035, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, DR-1, DR-3, REQ-042, REQ-043, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, PR-3, AC-1, AC-4, and AC-10 / Component: AI Assistant transport and outbound serialization - use the exact exported class symbol ApiAIAssistant from the exact case-sensitive module path packages/@webex/contact-center/src/services/ApiAiAssistant.ts (the filename casing does not rename the live symbol); add ApiAIAssistant.sendSummaryGetEvent and sendSummaryResponseEvent, with package-internal SummaryGetEventName and SummaryResponseEventName aliases in ApiAiAssistant.ts derived from the six AIAssistantEventName member value types rather than repeated string literals, reusing getBaseUrl, credentials, /event, POST, auth, getErrorDetails, core TIMEOUT_REQ, and package-internal AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE. In ApiAiAssistant.ts, declare package-internal source-module exports AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS = TIMEOUT_REQ and AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_ERROR_CODES with exact VALIDATION_FAILED = AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_VALIDATION_FAILED, HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED = AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED, and TIMEOUT = AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT values; omit both from the package root. Add one private buildSummaryEventEnvelope helper with a discriminated GET/response input; both public methods must call it, it alone constructs every HTTP body level field-by-field with no caller-object or partial-object spread, it writes the shared agentId/orgId/eventType/eventName/publishTimestamp/eventDetails.data identifier/clientType/actionTimeStamp envelope, and its response branch selects only the allowed flow fields. Reject a missing/unknown base URL with root-exported AI_SUMMARY_ERROR_CODES.AI_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL_NOT_AVAILABLE in both Error.message and data.errorCode. Inside both async methods, reject rather than synchronously throw with exact transport VALIDATION_FAILED message/data.errorCode for empty agentId, derived orgId, interactionId, or conversationId, an event name outside that method's three-member union, or invalid response timestamps; perform this validation before base-URL resolution, body construction, timers, and webex.request. Serialize independently derived conversationId and interactionId without collapsing them. For GET requests, capture one Date.now() value for both timestamps. For responses, preserve independently supplied finite non-negative actionTimeStamp and publishTimestamp values, capture one fallback Date.now() per call, and use it only for omitted fields. Omit the SDK-only summaryReceived discriminator; a mid-call body must have no wrapUpCode key and a post-call body no agentName key, including no undefined-valued key. Add one private bounded-post helper used by both methods: make one webex.request attempt with timeout: AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS, race it with one same-duration guard so an injected never-settling Promise still settles, attach the late rejection handler immediately, clear the guard in finally, return void on success, normalize the guard or exact ETIMEDOUT result to transport TIMEOUT, and never retry; the one-attempt assertions are the FR-12 no-automatic-retry evidence. For every other HTTP rejection, read only an optional finite numeric top-level statusCode, discard the original error, create a fresh projection from the bounded request-failure code, method/event, and safe identifiers, and pass only that projection to getErrorDetails or diagnostics; never forward or stringify the original message, stack, request, options, body, response, details, or cause. Extend the existing case-sensitive ApiAiAssistant Jest target with complete toStrictEqual request-object tests for all six names through the shared builder, not.toHaveProperty assertions for every flow-invalid key, request clock reuse, distinct supplied response timestamps, one-field/two-field fallback, post-call/consult/transfer/cancel happy paths, Promise-only table-driven validation rejection with no HTTP for every empty identifier and both out-of-union event directions, one HTTP attempt carrying the timeout, fake-timer TIMEOUT rejection and zero stale guards for never-resolving GET and response paths, and a privacy case whose rejected error carries the serialized body—with distinct summary, human-authored section-key, section-value, Adaptive-Card, and agentName sentinels—through message/request/options/response/cause while the returned error and every logger/metric spy omit every sentinel, including both the key and value. The focused adapter suite is acceptance evidence only for the outbound-serialization portion of AC-1, the cancellation-serialization portion of AC-4, the adapter privacy boundary of AC-10, and exact CONSULT/TRANSFER request/response wire-name selection for the SDK-side slice of FR-6/AC-2/AC-3; AC-2/AC-3 typed settlement remains with realtime coordination. Application response-before-handoff invocation order is documentation-only and outside the SDK automated-test boundary; no adapter or Task test claims it. This task is the REQ-056 sanitized HTTP-failure and bounded-transport implementation owner and depends on define-ai-summary-contracts for exact discriminants, transport types, public/internal export boundaries, and the client-type constant.

tasks.title: Coordinate pending requests and receiving-agent delivery
tasks.description: G-3, G-4, REQ-006, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-012, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, DR-5, REQ-044, REQ-045, REQ-046, REQ-047, REQ-048, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, PR-3, AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, and AC-11 / Component: Realtime coordination, correlation, and receiver delivery - add tryGetAISummaryCorrelation with the exact {conversationId, interactionId} return shape (conversationId = mainInteractionId ?? interactionId; interactionId = the task's top-level interactionId) or undefined for an empty identifier, and implement getAISummaryCorrelation as the throwing wrapper that throws AI_SUMMARY_CORRELATION_NOT_AVAILABLE only for Task outbound API validation. TaskManager must use the non-throwing helper for every AI-summary registry scan and lifecycle derivation, skip an invalid task with the bounded {reason: 'invalid-task-correlation', scanContext, taskId} metadata-only warning, and continue the RTD/lifecycle callback. Add a package-internal AISummaryCoordinator implementing the narrow request-coordinator interface. TaskManager lifecycle-owns one coordinator and the FR-11 request, FR-8 receiver-buffer, and orphan-feature timer/lifecycle policies, while AISummaryCoordinator directly owns the event-type-indexed pendingAISummaryRequests registry, receivingSummaryBuffer, interactionFeatureEnablement, and all timer handles. Arm the request timer only with accepted pending insertion, the receiver timer only with zero-candidate buffer insertion/replacement, and the feature timer only for a snapshot whose canonical interaction key has no registered task; use removeTimedEntry so resolution, inbound timeout, owner-task cleanup, and full-session cleanup clear the timer, settle while keyed, and delete before Promise reactions; owner-and-requestToken-checked base-URL/HTTP cleanup calls the same helper without a settlement callback, and receiver/feature paths clear/delete before their external outcome. Use AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS for pending requests, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS for receiver buffers, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS for orphan feature snapshots, with all three exported source-module aliases backed by the single AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS value and package-internal AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED reserved for owner-task/full-session lifecycle settlement; preserve exact validated event-type correlation, timeout/overlap/late-event outcomes, latest-only buffering, ambiguity protection, and scoped/full cleanup. For a valid subsequent-agent payload, TaskManager collects all valid conversation matches. It returns zero/one unchanged; for multiple matches it builds the set of local interaction.callProcessingDetails.parentInteractionId values, excludes every candidate whose interactionId is referenced as an ancestor, and selects the result only when exactly one leaf remains. One original match or unique leaf delivers independent of registry order. Zero original matches alone buffers/replaces and arms AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS. Zero or multiple leaves are irreducibly ambiguous: clear any old buffer, emit no task event, and report exactly one metadata-only AI_SUMMARY_INBOUND_EVENT_DROPPED with dropReason ambiguous-receiver. The same selector runs for buffer flush after insertion/update/removal; one delivers, zero retains its deadline, and ambiguity clears/drops. Buffer expiry is separate and reports receiver-buffer-expired exactly once. Individual removal never blindly deletes receiver state. Delivery, replacement, expiry, and unscoped full-session cleanup remove receiver state through the same private removeTimedEntry helper; receiver expiry additionally invokes TaskManager's bounded metric callback exactly once with receiver-buffer-expired, separately from the ambiguous-receiver callback, and uses only the fixed event/reason and no summary text, section key or value, Adaptive Card body, agentName, raw payload, or arbitrary exception text; a new-registration/connection-re-establishment reset or full SDK deregistration clears rather than re-flushes. Use payload.interactionId as the feature map key only when it exactly equals the top-level TaskData.interactionId produced as get/tryGetAISummaryCorrelation(...).interactionId. This remains the task child's own top-level identifier when mainInteractionId supplies a different conversation key. TaskManager writer presence checks, task-registration promotion, and final-task cleanup use tryGetAISummaryCorrelation, while Task request gating uses getAISummaryCorrelation; neither path substitutes conversationId/mainInteractionId. A frame keyed by that differing conversation value creates no enabled snapshot for the task and gating remains disabled, with no fallback. When no matching per-interaction event has arrived, the interactionFeatureEnablement lookup for the task's canonical key remains undefined, which Task's strict-true gate treats as disabled without registration, a timer, or HTTP. Validate postCallEnabled and midCallEnabled independently as absent or boolean, pass the original valid payload to AISummaryCoordinator, and store each flag as raw true | false | undefined without coercion; request gating permits only the selected flag === true. Store an unmatched feature snapshot with AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, remove that timer when a matching task registers, retain active state only for the matching task lifecycle, and clear every form during full cleanup. TaskManager remains the raw double-envelope parser and task-registry owner, holds the current profile-derived ConfigFlags view, exposes the bound getGeneratedSummaryFlags accessor injected into every Task, composes exactly one coordinator for its own lifetime, derives complete conversation-matching task candidate sets from defined tryGetAISummaryCorrelation results only, and delegates only validated payloads/state transitions while preserving transcript and suggested-response routing. Represent the logical pending key of conversationId plus inbound summary type as a conversation-keyed map per event type because FR-9 exposes no task/request identifier; make each entry generic in its event type so its resolver accepts exactly AISummaryPayloadByInboundType[T] and the paired async registration returns AISummaryPendingRegistration<T>, whose result is that exact Promise payload without a Task assertion. Implement registerPendingAISummaryRequest as an async method with no internal await: atomically check the key, reject its registration Promise with augmented AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING before constructing an inbound-result Promise, insertion, or timer arm when occupied, otherwise insert and resolve with the result-Promise handle; Task awaits acceptance before HTTP, so overlap cannot start HTTP. Require taskId as the lifecycle ownership guard and create/store a fresh opaque requestToken in every accepted handle/entry. Define cancelPendingAISummaryRequest(taskId, conversationId, inboundType, requestToken) only for base-URL/HTTP failure: missing key, owner mismatch, or stale token is a no-op; an exact match clears the timer/key through removeTimedEntry without resolving or rejecting registration.result. Task's acknowledgement handler then rethrows the unchanged adapter/base-URL error. Owner-task and full-session cleanup alone settle with AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED. Treat CONSULT and TRANSFER as one MID_CALL_SUMMARY slot despite their distinct outbound names. Classify FEATURE_ENABLEMENT before inner-payload validation. For every valid frame, including every identical repeat, emit the normal receive-path AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ENABLEMENT_RECEIVED counter exactly once and forward/store the payload; this counter is not a failure metric. A classified payload-invalid frame also emits it once with a bounded invalid validation outcome for rollout visibility but is not forwarded/stored, while unparseable or unclassifiable frames are excluded from that metric. A valid-frame metric records both exact tags postCallEnabled and midCallEnabled, using the validated boolean when present and the bounded string 'absent' when missing, never undefined; an invalid-frame metric includes only a bounded validation code and no unvalidated flag. For every valid FEATURE_ENABLEMENT payload, TaskManager's raw RTD parser calls AISummaryCoordinator.setFeatureEnablement(payload, hasRegisteredTask) before emitting AGENT_EVENTS.FEATURE_ENABLEMENT through TaskManager's EventEmitter without importing ContactCenter; Task request gating reads the latest raw snapshot through the injected coordinator's getFeatureEnablement accessor using the same canonical top-level interaction key. Implement the complete coordinator surface from the design inventory: getFeatureEnablement, async registerPendingAISummaryRequest, cancelPendingAISummaryRequest, setFeatureEnablement, retainFeatureEnablementForTask, clearFeatureEnablement, resolvePendingAISummaryRequest, routeReceivingSummary, flushReceivingSummary, clearTaskAISummaryState, and clearAISummaryState. TaskManager.clearAISummaryState first marks AI-summary inbound handling inactive and then invokes coordinator cleanup, which clears each associated request timer, rejects its still-pending post-call or mid-call result Promise with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED while the key remains occupied, deletes that key before Promise reactions, and clears receiver buffers, feature snapshots, and their timers. Any classified AI-summary frame received while inactive is dropped exactly once with bounded sdk-deregistered metadata and cannot resolve, buffer, mutate, emit, or recreate a timer; the next registration profile refresh through setConfigFlags reactivates handling. Emit AI_SUMMARY_INBOUND_EVENT_DROPPED exactly once with a bounded reason for each malformed, unknown, late, uncorrelated, irreducibly ambiguous receiver, or receiver-buffer-expired outcome, without double-counting classified invalid feature frames. For malformed, late, uncorrelated, and buffered receiver input, log or metric only bounded event/outcome metadata and never summary text, section keys or values, Adaptive Card bodies, raw envelopes, or arbitrary exception text. Add direct AISummaryCoordinator fake-timer and typed-contract tests that import AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, prove each equals AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, and cover exact post-call/mid-call payload inference without assertions, the exact request/buffer/orphan-feature arm points, resolver settlement, exact-token transport clear with zero resolver/rejector calls, stale-token safety, and owner/full lifecycle settlement with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED, Promise-only overlap rejection from awaited registration with no new result Promise or timer, first-entry retention through resolver/rejector settlement, deletion before Promise reactions, immediate sequential registration after every terminal outcome, owner cleanup, canonical feature-key writer/reader/registration/cleanup parity including a child task whose mainInteractionId differs and is never used as fallback, raw true/false/undefined flag retention, orphan replacement/expiry and task promotion, zero-match buffer/replacement, insertion/update/removal re-selection, unique parent/child and chained-leaf delivery independent of registry order, irreducible sibling/missing/cyclic lineage with one ambiguous-receiver callback, separate receiver-buffer-expired callback, sensitive sentinel absence including distinct human-authored section-key and section-value sentinels, and scoped/full cleanup, privacy, shared-duration boundaries, exact exported timeout/overlap codes, and no stale timers on every cleanup path; keep TaskManager tests focused on parsing, validation, delegation, deterministic local-lineage candidate selection with parent+child/chained/sibling/missing/cyclic cases and exact ambiguity/expiry metrics, a registered task with an empty interactionId that is skipped without throwing while a sole valid peer still receives or a no-valid-candidate frame buffers, flush after task registration/listener availability and after post-registry-delete task removal, feature enablement no-matching-event lookup remaining undefined, raw-tri-state store/read, boolean-or-'absent' valid metric tags, differing-event latest replacement, identical-event non-deduplicated delegation/emission, top-level-interaction-only lookup with no conversation-key fallback, final-task eviction, clearAISummaryState rejection of simultaneous post-call and mid-call pending Promises with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED plus full request/buffer/feature/timer eviction, one post-clear frame per summary discriminator producing only a bounded sdk-deregistered drop with no new state or event, setConfigFlags reactivation for the next registration, proof that legacy initiator aliases are never emitted; MetricsManager.trackEvent spies for one AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ENABLEMENT_RECEIVED metric on valid, repeated, and classified-invalid frames and exactly one AI_SUMMARY_INBOUND_EVENT_DROPPED metric for each unparseable, malformed-envelope, unknown-event, invalid-payload, late-or-uncorrelated, sdk-deregistered, ambiguous-receiver, and fake-timer receiver-buffer-expired path; no duplicate Task-owned FR-11 timeout operation metric; lifecycle integration; and regressions; make TaskUtils tests prove tryGetAISummaryCorrelation returns undefined without throwing for empty identifiers while getAISummaryCorrelation throws the exact named error. This task owns the realtime slices of REQ-010, REQ-056, and PR-3: timeout, unknown-task, malformed/uncorrelated/late-event isolation, scoped/full cleanup, and the named AC state/RTD assertions; it does not claim public Task selection, adapter serialization, or consumer sequencing. It depends only on contract types so it can proceed independently of HTTP transport.

tasks.title: Expose task summary request and response APIs
tasks.description: G-1, G-2, G-4, G-5, REQ-005, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, DR-1, DR-2, DR-3, DR-4, REQ-040, REQ-041, REQ-042, REQ-043, REQ-044, REQ-045, REQ-049, REQ-050, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-10, and AC-11 / Component: Public contracts and task API plus Change: Consumer sequencing and response semantics - implement Task.configureAISummary, requestPostCallSummary, sendPostCallSummaryResponse, requestMidCallSummary, and sendMidCallSummaryResponse as additive inherited Task methods; validate structured-or-text/empty shapes using the required mid-call summaryReceived: true | false discriminant, finite non-negative counters, optional finite non-negative actionTimeStamp/publishTimestamp fields, closed action/state/feedback vocabularies, non-empty post-call wrapUpCode, and non-empty mid-call agentName; derive distinct conversationId and top-level interactionId through getAISummaryCorrelation. Populate both identifiers from the requesting Task on every request and response, including NOT_RECEIVED and summaryReceived: false. After a post-call request passes its exact enablement gate and agent/correlation validation, capture a Task-private readonly {conversationId, interactionId} response context before registration/HTTP; retain it, the configured agentId, and the injected adapter across wrap-up-driven TaskManager collection/coordinator/feature cleanup. sendPostCallSummaryResponse uses that retained context and adapter without a live registry, feature snapshot, coordinator entry, or gating read (falling back to current Task data only for a direct response without a prior gated request); full ContactCenter deregistration ends the supported operation window. Scope literal empty/zero unavailable sentinels only to summary and numberOfTimesViewed/numberOfTimesEdited/numberOfTimesCopied, never to correlation identifiers. Call the injected getGeneratedSummaryFlags accessor on every request so Tasks created before setConfigFlags refreshes still observe the current organization kill switches. For post-call, derive interactionId as the canonical top-level TaskData.interactionId from getAISummaryCorrelation and require both current wrapUpSummariesEnabled and the latest per-interaction postCallEnabled read through coordinator.getFeatureEnablement(interactionId) to be exactly true or reject POST_CALL_SUMMARY_DISABLED; for mid-call, require current consultTransferSummariesEnabled and the latest per-interaction midCallEnabled read through the same coordinator getter to be exactly true or reject MID_CALL_SUMMARY_DISABLED. When mainInteractionId differs, it remains conversationId and is never retried as the feature lookup key; a mismatched frame or raw undefined flag therefore stays disabled. Each disabled path creates no pending entry/timer and makes no HTTP call. Before HTTP, await registerPendingAISummaryRequest with the literal inbound type/timeout so TypeScript infers a handle containing the exact payload Promise plus a fresh opaque requestToken. Overlap rejects before handle/token/result construction, timer, or HTTP. Wrap only the HTTP acknowledgement branch with a rejection handler that calls cancelPendingAISummaryRequest(taskId, conversationId, inboundType, registration.requestToken); exact owner/token cleanup clears the timer/key without settling registration.result, then rethrows the identical base-URL/adapter error. Compose that wrapped acknowledgement with registration.result through Promise.all before either branch can settle. AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED is reserved for task/full-session lifecycle cleanup. A stale late acknowledgement token cannot clear a newer same-key registration, while overlap performs no cancellation and leaves the first request pending. Select exact variants; pass counters and either supplied response timestamp independently and unchanged through a newly constructed whitelist object; never spread the caller payload; capture one method-local operationStartedAt before validation in every public method, never call the singleton MetricsManager.timeEvent for AI-summary operations, and emit exactly one final trackEvent per invocation with its own non-negative duration_ms and without summary text, section keys or values, Adaptive Card bodies, agentName, raw payloads, or arbitrary exception text. The two request methods record success only after the HTTP acknowledgement and matching RTD result both fulfill the public aggregate Promise; the two response methods have no RTD result and record success when their bounded HTTP acknowledgement fulfills. Post-call response failures emit AI_SUMMARY_POST_CALL_RESPONSE_FAILED for AI_SUMMARY_INVALID_RESPONSE_PAYLOAD, AI_SUMMARY_NOT_INITIALIZED, AI_SUMMARY_CORRELATION_NOT_AVAILABLE, AI_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL_NOT_AVAILABLE, and every package-internal transport failure; mid-call response failures emit AI_SUMMARY_MID_CALL_RESPONSE_FAILED for the same closed set plus AI_SUMMARY_INVALID_ACTION_TYPE. Every such failure, including one before HTTP, carries only the bounded failureCode. Make package-internal Task.configureAISummary the sole injection point: immediately after every TaskFactory.createTask call and before listener setup or registry insertion, TaskManager passes its one lifetime-scoped AISummaryCoordinator through the AISummaryRequestCoordinator contract plus its bound GeneratedSummaryFlagsAccessor. Task retains the injected adapter, narrow coordinator/accessor references, configured agent identity, and private post-call response context, but never imports TaskManager, the config service, or the concrete coordinator; TaskFactory and subclass constructors stay unchanged. Extend Task tests with mid-call discriminator branch, invalid/missing discriminator, transport-omission assertions, received MID_CALL_CANCELLED viewed-zero-before-display acceptance plus exact first-open viewed-one with edited/copied zero unless those actions occurred, optional timestamp pass-through on every response branch, and string/NaN/infinite/negative timestamp rejection before transport; per-invocation/live-update organization-accessor assertions; exact post-call and mid-call two-flag disabled codes for false, raw undefined, and a differing mainInteractionId frame-key mismatch with no conversation-key fallback and no registration/timer/HTTP;
